notes.title: Doomed Otaku - Steam Demo Now Available
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360610/__Demo/

Hello! We are KiwiSaurus, the development team behind Doomed Otaku.
The new demo(v.0.3.6) is now available on Steam!
If you enjoyed it, please consider adding it to your wishlist and leaving a comment.
Doomed Otaku demo is currently available only in Korean, but an English translation will be added in the future.

Here are the updated contents.

[h3] ※Update Details※ [/h3]
[list]
[b][*]Added Day 2 (Reality) event
[*]Holding the Z key now allows script skipping
[*]Save/Load feature added
[*]Date selection available in save slots
[*]bug fixes[/b]
[/list]
[Bug reports] [url=https://discord.com/invite/dmqfTkKC9Q]discord[/url]
[contact] kiwisaurus1130@gmail.com



Doomed Otaku will be featured at the Indie Live Expo today, April 13th, at 6 PM! We appreciate your interest.
